name: Slater Park Summer Camp
operator_name: City of Pawtucket Parks & Recreation Division
description_short: The City of Pawtucket's summer day camp in Slater Memorial Park for Pawtucket residents ages 6-13, 9:00am-2:00pm on weekdays in two 3-week sessions. Campers do sports, arts and crafts, field games, nature walks and water games, with free lunch, pool days and paid field trips.

sources.note: City announcement page for the 2026 packet; 'Registration opens this Friday, May 1st'.

Scanned 2026 registration packet (read as images, pages 1-9 and 12): ages 6-13; June 29 - August 7, 2026, 9:00AM-2:00PM; Session 1 June 29 - July 17, Session 2 July 20 - August 7; $40 per session / $80 both; lunch free; Pawtucket residents only; online registration May 1 via RecDesk, in person May 16, 2026.

refund_policy_summary: Camp fees are non-refundable (all sales final). Field trip money is not refunded unless the trip is cancelled. A camper with more than 4 absences in a session can lose the spot to the waiting list, with no refund.
